answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 9036 Country: India Title: Is it sunnah to go to qabrestaan every eid day or any other day to give fateha to your relative? and why can't you pray dua from your home. Prayer at home dosen't reach to allah?please answer Question: Is it sunnah to go to qabrestaan every eid day or any other day to give fateha to your relative? and why can't you pray dua from your home. Prayer at home dosen't reach to allah?please answer Answer ID: 9036 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1158/1158=M/1429) It is written in books that visiting graveyard on Eid day is mustahab (desirable). One should visit graves now and then at other occasions as well. In some nights, especially the Night of Bara?ah it is proved that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) visited graves. One can pray for the dead from his home as well and that prayer is acceptable before Allah, but by visiting graves one is reminded of the world hereafter and death, therefore it is better to visit them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
